surface.brief: The Board's Unattached agents section (#agents) at 1440x900
surface.change: make the section say where an unattached card's directory actually is and offer the tree that directory belongs to
surface.scope: the whole #agents section: its .project-head bar and #jobs with every card

round.codeIdenticalEvidence: git diff --stat 99f2bd777a2a24d1aedd903e9c4b24a4d9520c36 132354c1 -- public lib server.js is empty; the change-set was then applied with git apply -p1

open: Fresh browser context at 1440x900, device scale factor 1 (no localStorage, so every section is at its default).
wait for #agents and for #jobs to hold two .job[data-thread] cards (the seeded unattached store).
assert #agents is not collapsed, #jobs is painted, no .attach-row is visible, and every card draws a .job-cwd line.
wait two animation frames, then a further 300 ms for the last paint.
expanded: Reach the open state exactly as above.
click [data-attach-toggle="fixture-tree-worker"] (the card whose cwd is a worktree the board has not read).
wait for that card's .attach-row to lose [hidden] and for its select to hold options.
assert the attach row is painted, the select is populated, and the Attach press carries its disabled state as measured.
wait two animation frames, then a further 300 ms for the last paint.
collapsed: Reach the expanded state exactly as above.
click .project-head[data-toggle-fixed="agents"] (the section's own bar, not one of its buttons).
wait for #agents to carry .fixed-collapsed and for #jobs to report display:none and no painted box.
assert the bar is still painted and its label still names the section.
wait two animation frames, then a further 300 ms for the last paint.

shots_verified.note: shot hashes are of the PNG bytes and repeat on any checkout; the .json/.css hashes in this record are of this run's LF files, which is the committed blob form, while a Windows checkout materialises ledger .json/.html as CRLF
